application.meaning: Represent purpose, owners, dependencies, hierarchy, identities, rationale, source lineage, revision and relevant state transitions as meaningful typed relationships. Merely wrapping prose in JSON is insufficient. Scale detail to the task; small reversible work does not require a new Work, Task or Goal.

Required native interface formats, including Python, YAML and SKILL.md, retain their established native/source owners.

application.longWork: The separate standing long-work decision retains its qualifying entrusted-work conditions. This preference creates no native Goal or plan.

reasons.text: The user explicitly says Memory context, hierarchy, structure and typing minimize drift risk. This is the user's stated reason, not an empirical guarantee from this change.

reasons.dedup: U8/U9/U10 share legacy-answer-005.json: one original answer, not three confirmations.

reasons.text: All Leads and agents should operate through an Ontology with Domain-through-Task IDs for end-to-end audit and traceability.
Keep accepted intent, original questions/answers, hierarchy and pending work recoverable so interruption does not force repeated interviews.
Typed problem definitions and executable mechanisms make failure classes checkable; prose observations alone do not enforce behavior.

Select relevant purpose and dependency context rather than repeatedly reading flat history; measured spend per useful decision matters more than registration counts. No cost reduction is established by this source change.
One common implementation and thin native adapters reduce redundant maintenance while preserving real native runtime and domain data owners. Repository names do not define native profile identities.
